en: Dependent on a non-material, non-visible, non-reacting phenomenon, a material, visible, reacting phenomenon arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three for root, three for predominance … pe … three for non-disappearance.
Dependent on a non-material, non-visible, non-reacting phenomenon, a material, invisible, reacting phenomenon arises by way of root condition.
(Abbreviated. Three for root, three for predominance … pe … [three] for mutuality.

Dependent on a state that is non-material, invisible, and non-reacting, there arises a state that is material, invisible, and non-reacting, by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. One for root, one for predominance ... pe ... one for non-disappearance.
